Chat request with tool_choice specifying a particular function to call

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
api_key = ENV.fetch("API_KEY")
client = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
result = client.chat_async(LiterLlm::ChatCompletionRequest.new(messages: [{ 'content' => 'What is the weather in Paris?', 'role' => 'user' }], model: 'gpt-4', tool_choice: { 'function' => { 'name' => 'get_weather' }, 'type' => 'function' }, tools: [LiterLlm::ChatCompletionTool.new(function: LiterLlm::FunctionDefinition.new(description: 'Get the current weather for a given location', name: 'get_weather', parameters: '{"properties":{"location":{"description":"The city name","type":"string"}},"required":["location"],"type":"object"}'), tool_type: 'function'), LiterLlm::ChatCompletionTool.new(function: LiterLlm::FunctionDefinition.new(description: 'Search the web for information', name: 'search_web', parameters: '{"properties":{"query":{"description":"The search query","type":"string"}},"required":["query"],"type":"object"}'), tool_type: 'function')]))
puts result.choices.inspect
puts result.choices[0].message.tool_calls.inspect
puts result.choices[0].message.tool_calls[0].function.name.inspect
puts result.choices[0].finish_reason.inspect
```
